tuto.welcome:
Welcome to the Verso tutorial!
Your goal is to score as many victory points as possible by completing sets of cards or forming squares.
tuto.deck:
Here's the Back card deck.
In <bold>Back</bold>, each card has two sides, each side different.
tuto.card: This card is blue (the sea), and its value is 4.
tuto.points:
It is worth 1 victory point.
A card always earns 1 victory point on one side, and 3 victory points on the other side.
tuto.verso: Additionally, the back of a card is always a different color. The back of this blue card is therefore either green (earth) or orange (sky), on the reverse.
tuto.flip:
Finally, the value of a card is always 1 more or 1 less on the back.
The back of this card must therefore have a value of 3 or 5.
Turn the card over.
tuto.place:
The back of this card is an orange 5, worth 3 victory points.
When it's your turn, if you choose to turn over the top card of the draw pile, you are forced to add it to your collection.
tuto.playerlayout:
This is your collection.
You can never have two cards of the same suit and value in your collection. If you have another orange 5, it will be immediately discarded.
tuto.opponent: It's your opponent's turn to play.
tuto.opponent.place: Your opponent added this card to their collection without turning it over.
tuto.place.without.flip: It's your turn. Add this card to your collection without turning it over.
tuto.choose.action:
It's your turn again.
On your turn, you have the choice between:
• taking a card
• validating a series
tuto.sequence: A series is made up of a sequence of 2 to 6 cards <bold>of the same suit</bold> whose values ​​are <bold>consecutive</bold>.
tuto.bank.validate: By validating a series, you score as many points as <bold>the number of victory points present at the top of the cards</bold> forming the series.
tuto.bank.discard: After validating a series, <bold>you discard the 2 highest value cards of this series</bold>.
tuto.bank.flip:
Finally, when you validate a set, your opponent must turn over their highest-ranking card of the same suit as that set.
<bold>If the back is a duplicate of a card they already have, they discard it!</bold>
<italic>With 4 or more players, only the left and right neighbors turn over a card</italic>
tuto.joker: This card is a wild card. It can replace any value in a series!
tuto.score:
There are two ways to score points in Verso:
• Validate a series
• Form a square of 9 cards (3 of each suit)
tuto.square:
As soon as you have 3 cards of each suit, you score 7 points.
You must then break your four-of-a-kind (for example, by completing a series) before you can score 7 points again.
tuto.end: The end of the game is triggered as soon as the draw pile is empty. Each player can then declare a final sequence.
tuto.go:
Now it's your turn: will you declare your set, or will you take a card? Will you turn it over before taking it?
Good luck!
rules.solo.text.1: Each turn, you must choose either to draw a card OR bank a sequence.
rules.solo.text.2: Following your turn, you simulate an opponent taking their turn by flipping the top card of the deck to reveal its reverse side.
rules.solo.text.3: If one of the faces on your opponent’s card is a joker: Nothing happens.
rules.solo.text.4: If the number on the reverse side of your opponent’s card is higher than the number on the side initially visible: Flip your highest numbered card in the same color as the reverse side.
rules.solo.text.5: Finally, discard your opponent’s card and play your next turn.
